verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
TUSAASIRE ffe-abanaku,
Tuzirise olw'ebibi;
Otubeere-Omulokozi
Kubanga ggwe osaasira.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Tusonyiwe abeeneya,
Tutambule mu maaso go
Ng'aboonoonyi-abasonyiwe,
Tukwebaze-Omulokozi.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Tuzze gy'oli-Omulokozi,
Ggwe eyafa ku lw'abantu
Naffe fenna aboonoonyi
Tumanyi nti osaasira.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Tetukyatya omulabe,
Takyalina maanyi gonna:
Kale leka tukwesige,
Tusaasire -Omulokozi
